// Go side of the recur-store compatibility proof. Copy into internal/store
// as zz_rustfixture_test.go and run from the repo root, then delete the copy.
//
// Generate (writes go_store.db, go_dump.json, go_schema.json):
//
//	RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE_DIR=$PWD/rust/crates/store/tests/fixtures \
//	  go test ./internal/store -run TestRustStoreFixture -count=1
//
// Verify a Rust-written DB (reads rust_written.db, checks Go-side
// expectations, writes go_reads_rust.json):
//
//	RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE_DIR=$PWD/rust/crates/store/tests/fixtures RECUR_RUST_VERIFY=1 \
//	  go test ./internal/store -run TestRustStoreFixture -count=1
//
// rustFixtureDump must stay in step with `dump` in tests/compat.rs.
package store

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"recur/internal/domain"
)

func rustFixtureDump(t *testing.T, s *Store) map[string]any {
	t.Helper()
	wsIDs := map[string]bool{}
	for _, w := range s.Workspaces() {
		wsIDs[w.ID] = true
	}
	s.mu.RLock()
	for id := range s.agents {
		wsIDs[id] = true
	}
	for id := range s.feed {
		wsIDs[id] = true
	}
	for id := range s.findings {
		wsIDs[id] = true
	}
	seq := s.prNumberSeq
	rules := map[string]any{}
	for k, r := range s.githubBranchRules {
		rules[k] = map[string]any{"require": r.Require, "atMs": r.At.UnixMilli()}
	}
	projectIDs := []string{}
	for _, p := range s.projects {
		projectIDs = append(projectIDs, p.ID)
	}
	s.mu.RUnlock()
	for id := range s.SessionHeadersByWorkspace() {
		wsIDs[id] = true
	}

	var sessionIDs []string
	byWs := map[string]any{}
	for id := range wsIDs {
		var esc any
		if e, ok := s.Escalation(id); ok {
			esc = e
		}
		var pr any
		if p, ok := s.PRByWorkspace(id); ok {
			pr = p
		}
		var openPR any
		if p, ok := s.OpenPRByWorkspace(id); ok {
			openPR = p
		}
		events, err := s.EventsForLoop(id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sessions := s.SessionsForLoop(id)
		for _, sess := range sessions {
			sessionIDs = append(sessionIDs, sess.ID)
		}
		byWs[id] = map[string]any{
			"agents":            s.Agents(id),
			"feed":              s.Feed(id),
			"findings":          s.Findings(id),
			"openFindings":      s.OpenFindings(id),
			"escalation":        esc,
			"hasOpenEscalation": s.HasOpenEscalation(id),
			"events":            events,
			"sessions":          sessions,
			"lastAssistantText": s.LastAssistantText(id),
			"prByWorkspace":     pr,
			"openPRByWorkspace": openPR,
		}
	}
	apps := s.SessionsForAppKind(domain.SessionKindApp)
	for _, sess := range apps {
		sessionIDs = append(sessionIDs, sess.ID)
	}
	sort.Strings(sessionIDs)
	transcripts := map[string]any{}
	contexts := map[string]any{}
	firstPrompts := map[string]any{}
	for _, id := range sessionIDs {
		msgs, err := s.SessionTranscript(id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		transcripts[id] = msgs
		if c, ok := s.ActiveSessionContext(id); ok {
			contexts[id] = c
		} else {
			contexts[id] = nil
		}
		firstPrompts[id] = s.SessionFirstUserPrompt(id)
	}
	prByID := map[string]any{}
	for _, p := range s.PRs() {
		full, _ := s.PR(p.ID)
		prByID[p.ID] = full
	}
	analysis := map[string]any{}
	for _, id := range projectIDs {
		if a, ok := s.LatestAnalysis(id, ""); ok {
			analysis[id] = a
		}
	}
	schedules, err := s.ScheduledPrompts()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	runs, err := s.ScheduledPromptRuns()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	active, err := s.ActiveScheduledPromptRuns()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return map[string]any{
		"projectGroups":     s.ProjectGroups(),
		"projects":          s.Projects(),
		"workspaces":        s.Workspaces(),
		"byWorkspace":       byWs,
		"prs":               s.PRs(),
		"prById":            prByID,
		"inbox":             s.Inbox(),
		"policy":            s.Policy(),
		"settings":          s.Settings(),
		"resource":          s.Resource(),
		"attention":         s.AttentionCounts(),
		"unreadCount":       s.UnreadCount(),
		"unseenChatCount":   s.UnseenChatCount(),
		"prNumberSeq":       seq,
		"githubBranchRules": rules,
		"latestAnalysis":    analysis,
		"appSessions":       apps,
		"transcripts":       transcripts,
		"activeContexts":    contexts,
		"firstUserPrompts":  firstPrompts,
		"sessionHeaders":    s.SessionHeadersByWorkspace(),
		"latestEventTS":     s.LatestEventTSByWorkspace(),
		"schedules":         schedules,
		"scheduleRuns":      runs,
		"activeRuns":        active,
	}
}

func rustSchemaDump(t *testing.T, path string) map[string]any {
	t.Helper()
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()
	rows, err := db.Query(`SELECT type, name, tbl_name, COALESCE(sql, '') FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type, name`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var objects []map[string]string
	for rows.Next() {
		var typ, name, tbl, q string
		if err := rows.Scan(&typ, &name, &tbl, &q); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		objects = append(objects, map[string]string{"type": typ, "name": name, "tbl_name": tbl, "sql": q})
	}
	rows.Close()
	mrows, err := db.Query(`SELECT version, name FROM __migrations ORDER BY version`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var migrations []map[string]any
	for mrows.Next() {
		var v int
		var n string
		if err := mrows.Scan(&v, &n); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		migrations = append(migrations, map[string]any{"version": v, "name": n})
	}
	mrows.Close()
	return map[string]any{"objects": objects, "migrations": migrations}
}

func writeRustFixtureJSON(t *testing.T, path string, v any) {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func copyRustFixtureDB(t *testing.T, src string) string {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(src)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dst := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "recur.db")
	if err := os.WriteFile(dst, data, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return dst
}

func must(t *testing.T, err error) {
	t.Helper()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// rustPopulate writes every kind of row the store persists.
func rustPopulate(t *testing.T, s *Store) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.seedDemo()
	must(t, s.db.seedAll(s))
	s.mu.Unlock()

	_, err := s.AddProjectGroup(domain.ProjectGroup{ID: "grp", Name: "Group <&>  ", Open: true})
	must(t, err)
	p, _ := s.Project("storefront")
	p.GroupID = "grp"
	p.Hidden = true
	p.PROnGitHub = true
	p.LinearProjects = "ACME, Web"
	p.MergeMethod = domain.MergeMethodSquash
	p.DisabledSkills = []string{"noise"}
	p.EnabledMCP = []string{"linear"}
	_, err = s.UpdateProjectRunConfig(p)
	must(t, err)
	_, err = s.AddProject(domain.Project{
		ID: "extra", Name: "extra", RepoPath: "/nonexistent/recur-fixture/extra", BaseBranch: "dev",
		Color: "#ffcc00", Pic: "lucide:box", DeleteBranchOnRemove: true,
		UpdateBaseMethod: domain.UpdateBaseRebase, SquashCommitMessage: domain.SquashCommitTitleAndDescription,
		MergeCommitMessage: domain.MergeCommitTitleAndDescription, EnabledSkills: []string{"special"}, DisabledMCP: []string{"acme"},
	})
	must(t, err)

	_, err = s.AddWorkspace(domain.Workspace{
		ID: "W-go", ProjectID: "extra", Group: domain.GroupActive, Goal: "Go fixture <b>goal</b>", State: domain.StateCoding,
		Progress: 0.25, ChatTabOrder: []string{"PA", "PA2"}, AgentCodes: []string{"PA"}, Port: 4321, Branch: "recur/go",
		Plan:   &domain.Plan{Summary: "plan", Body: "# body", Steps: []domain.PlanStep{{ID: "s1", Title: "First", Status: "done", Files: []string{"a.go"}}}},
		FanOut: &domain.ChildFanOut{Wave: 2, After: []string{"s1"}, Outcome: "merged"},
	})
	must(t, err)
	s.UpdateWorkspace("LOOP-2229", func(w *domain.Workspace) { w.Phase = "iteration 3"; w.Iteration = 3 })
	s.UpsertAgent("W-go", domain.Agent{ID: "W-go-PA", WorkspaceID: "W-go", Code: "PA", Name: "Agent", Unseen: true, SessionID: "sess-x"})
	s.UpsertAgent("W-go", domain.Agent{ID: "W-go-PA2", WorkspaceID: "W-go", Code: "PA2", Name: "Agent 2", Steps: []domain.AgentStep{{Kind: "read", Text: "x"}}})
	for i, id := range []string{"g1", "g2", "g3"} {
		s.PrependFeed("W-go", domain.FeedItem{ID: id, AgentCode: "PA", Name: "Agent", Text: "feed " + id, ToolUseID: "tu-" + id, Ts: int64(100 + i)})
	}
	s.PatchFeedByToolUseID("W-go", "tu-g2", func(it *domain.FeedItem) { it.ToolResult = "patched"; it.IsToolError = true })
	s.UpsertFeed("W-go", domain.FeedItem{ID: "card", Card: domain.FeedCardPlan, Data: `{"k":1}`, Text: "card"})

	f := s.AddFinding(domain.Finding{ID: "F-go-1", ShortID: "find_gofix01", WorkspaceID: "W-go", Iteration: 2, File: "a.go", Line: 3, EndLine: 9,
		Severity: domain.SevHigh, Message: "nil deref <&>", Summary: "**sum**", Status: "open", Source: ""})
	_, err = s.AddFindingNote("W-go", f.ID, "first note", domain.FindingActorHuman)
	must(t, err)
	_, err = s.AddFindingNote("W-go", f.ShortID, "second note", domain.FindingActorCoder)
	must(t, err)
	s.AddFinding(domain.Finding{ID: "F-go-2", ShortID: "find_gofix02", WorkspaceID: "W-go", File: "b.go", Severity: domain.SevLow, Message: "nit", Status: "open"})
	_, err = s.UpdateFindingStatus("W-go", "F-go-2", "invalid", "not a bug", domain.FindingActorCoder)
	must(t, err)

	s.AddAnalysis(domain.AnalysisRun{ID: "an-go", ProjectID: "storefront", Root: "/x", When: "now", TS: 1234,
		Metrics: domain.MetricSnapshot{Files: 3, LOC: 120, AvgComplexity: 2.5, MaxComplexity: 7}, Summary: "ok"})
	for i, typ := range []string{"workspace.event", "workspace.updated", "agent.step"} {
		_, err := s.AppendEvent(domain.StoredEvent{WorkspaceID: "W-go", AgentID: "W-go-PA", Type: typ, PayloadJSON: `{"i":` + string(rune('0'+i)) + `}`, TS: int64(1000 + i)})
		must(t, err)
	}
	s.SetGitHubBranchRequirePR("storefront", "acme/app", "main", true)
	s.SetGitHubBranchRequirePR("extra", "acme/extra", "dev", false)

	s.AddEscalation(domain.Escalation{ID: "esc-go", WorkspaceID: "W-go", AgentCode: "PA", Status: "open", Question: "Which?", Kind: "question",
		Options: []domain.EscalationOption{{Text: "A", Tag: "t", Desc: "d"}}})
	s.AnswerEscalation("LOOP-2218", "Token bucket with refill", "")
	s.MarkEscalationApplied("LOOP-2218")

	n := s.NextPRNumber()
	_, err = s.AddPR(domain.PR{ID: "480", WorkspaceID: "W-go", ProjectID: "extra", Number: n, Source: domain.SourceLocal, Title: "Local fixture PR",
		State: "In review", Group: "you", Files: []domain.FileDiff{{Path: "a.go", Status: "m", Lines: []domain.DiffLine{{Type: "add", New: "1", CodeHTML: "<b>x</b>"}}}}})
	must(t, err)
	s.AddInboxItem(domain.InboxItem{ID: "ib-chat-W-go-PA", Kind: "chat", Unread: true, Title: "chat", Target: "chat:W-go:PA", WorkspaceID: "W-go"})
	s.MarkInboxRead("ib3")

	sess, err := s.CreateSession(domain.Session{ID: "sess-go-1", WorkspaceID: "W-go", Kind: "pair", Provider: domain.ProviderClaudeCode,
		ConfigJSON: `{"code":"PA","title":"t <&>","flags":{"effort":"high"}}`})
	must(t, err)
	u, err := s.AppendMessage(sess.ID, domain.Message{ID: "m-go-1", Role: "user", Content: []domain.ContentBlock{
		domain.TextBlockDisplay("wire <prompt>", "shown prompt"), domain.ImageBlock("img1", "a.png", "image/png", "/tmp/a.png")}})
	must(t, err)
	mid, err := s.CreateMessage(sess.ID, domain.Message{ID: "m-go-2", Role: "assistant", ModelID: "claude-opus-4-8", Provider: domain.ProviderClaudeCode, StartedAt: 5})
	must(t, err)
	must(t, s.AppendContentBlock(mid, domain.ThinkingBlock("hmm", "sig", 0)))
	must(t, s.AppendContentBlock(mid, domain.TextBlock("Answer & <done>")))
	must(t, s.AppendContentBlock(mid, domain.ToolUseBlock("tu-go-1", "toolu_1", "mcp__recur__ask_user", json.RawMessage(`{ "q" : 1 }`))))
	must(t, s.PatchToolUseInput("tu-go-1", json.RawMessage(`{"question":"Ship?"}`)))
	must(t, s.AppendContentBlock(mid, domain.FallbackBlock("", "sonnet")))
	must(t, s.PatchFallbackFrom(mid, "opus"))
	must(t, s.CompleteMessage(mid, domain.StreamComplete, domain.Message{InputTokens: 10, OutputTokens: 20, CacheReadTokens: 30, DurationMS: 40, ContextWindow: 200000}))
	_, err = s.AppendMessage(sess.ID, domain.Message{ID: "m-go-3", Role: "user", Content: []domain.ContentBlock{
		domain.ToolResultBlock("tu-go-1", "yes", false), domain.CompactBlock(domain.CompactDone, "auto", "folded", 900),
		domain.RawBlock("future_block", json.RawMessage(`{"x":[1,2]}`))}})
	must(t, err)
	_, err = s.WriteSessionContext(sess.ID, "summary of turns", u.ID)
	must(t, err)
	must(t, s.PatchSessionConfigSimplify(sess.ID, false))
	must(t, s.UpdateSessionRef(sess.ID, "claude-ref-1"))
	_, err = s.ForkSession(sess.ID, mid, "coder", `{"code":"PA2","ownerCode":"PA"}`)
	must(t, err)
	_, err = s.CreateSession(domain.Session{ID: "sess-go-app", Kind: domain.SessionKindApp, Provider: domain.ProviderClaudeCode, ConfigJSON: `{"code":"APP","unseen":true}`})
	must(t, err)

	off := false
	sched := domain.ScheduledPrompt{ID: "sched-go", ProjectID: "extra", Name: "Nightly", Prompt: "check <it>", BaseBranch: "dev", Mode: "agent",
		Model: "claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5", Simplify: &off, Cadence: "cron", Cron: "0 3 * * *", TimeZone: "America/New_York",
		NextRunAt: 1767225600000, Flags: map[string]string{"effort": "low", "thinking": "on"}}
	must(t, s.SaveScheduledPrompt(sched))
	sched.NextRunAt = 1767312000000
	ok, err := s.ClaimScheduledPrompt(sched, domain.ScheduledPromptRun{ID: "run-go-1", ScheduleID: sched.ID, DueAt: 1767225600000, Status: "running"})
	must(t, err)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("claim failed")
	}
	must(t, s.LinkScheduledPromptRun("run-go-1", "W-go"))
	must(t, s.UpdateScheduledPromptRun(domain.ScheduledPromptRun{ID: "run-go-1", Status: "finished", Detail: "done"}))
}

func TestRustStoreFixture(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURE_DIR not set")
	}
	home := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("HOME", home)

	if os.Getenv("RECUR_RUST_VERIFY") != "" {
		path := copyRustFixtureDB(t, filepath.Join(dir, "rust_written.db"))
		s, err := open(path)
		must(t, err)
		defer s.Close()
		rustVerifyExpectations(t, s)
		writeRustFixtureJSON(t, filepath.Join(dir, "go_reads_rust.json"), rustFixtureDump(t, s))
		return
	}

	fresh := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "recur.db")
	fs, err := open(fresh)
	must(t, err)
	must(t, fs.Close())
	writeRustFixtureJSON(t, filepath.Join(dir, "go_schema.json"), rustSchemaDump(t, fresh))

	dbPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "recur.db")
	s, err := open(dbPath)
	must(t, err)
	rustPopulate(t, s)
	must(t, s.Close())
	data, err := os.ReadFile(dbPath)
	must(t, err)
	must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "go_store.db"), data, 0o644))

	s2, err := open(dbPath)
	must(t, err)
	defer s2.Close()
	writeRustFixtureJSON(t, filepath.Join(dir, "go_dump.json"), rustFixtureDump(t, s2))
}

// rustVerifyExpectations checks, with the Go store, the writes the Rust
// fixture generator (compat.rs generate_rust_written_db) made.
func rustVerifyExpectations(t *testing.T, s *Store) {
	t.Helper()
	fail := func(format string, args ...any) { t.Helper(); t.Errorf(format, args...) }
	p, ok := s.Project("rust-proj")
	if !ok || p.Color != "#00aaff" || !p.PROnGitHub || p.MergeMethod != domain.MergeMethodRebase || len(p.EnabledSkills) != 1 {
		fail("rust-proj = %+v ok=%v", p, ok)
	}
	if g, ok := s.ProjectGroup("rust-grp"); !ok || g.Name != "Rust group" || g.CreatedAt == "" {
		fail("rust-grp = %+v ok=%v", g, ok)
	}
	w, ok := s.Workspace("W-rust")
	if !ok || len(w.ChatTabOrder) != 1 || w.ChatTabOrder[0] != "PA" || w.Plan == nil || w.Plan.Steps[0].Title != "Rust step" {
		fail("W-rust = %+v ok=%v", w, ok)
	}
	if _, ok := s.Workspace("LOOP-2235"); ok {
		fail("LOOP-2235 should be deleted")
	}
	if got, _ := s.Workspace("LOOP-2231"); got.Phase != "rust phase" {
		fail("LOOP-2231 phase = %q", got.Phase)
	}
	if a, ok := s.Agent("W-rust", "PA"); !ok || !a.Unseen || a.SessionID != "rust-sess" {
		fail("W-rust PA = %+v ok=%v", a, ok)
	}
	feed := s.Feed("W-rust")
	if len(feed) != 3 || feed[0].ID != "r3" || feed[2].ID != "r1" || feed[1].ToolResult != "rust patched" {
		fail("W-rust feed = %+v", feed)
	}
	fs := s.Findings("W-rust")
	if len(fs) != 2 || len(fs[0].Notes) != 2 || fs[0].Notes[1].Author != domain.FindingActorCoder || fs[1].Status != "ignored" {
		fail("W-rust findings = %+v", fs)
	}
	if fs := s.Findings("W-go"); len(fs) != 2 || fs[0].Status != "resolved" {
		fail("W-go findings after Rust resolve = %+v", fs)
	}
	if e, ok := s.Escalation("W-rust"); !ok || e.Status != "answered" || e.Answer != "rust answer" {
		fail("W-rust escalation = %+v ok=%v", e, ok)
	}
	if pr, ok := s.PR("rust-pr"); !ok || pr.Number != 481 || pr.Source != domain.SourceLocal || pr.CreatedAt == "" {
		fail("rust-pr = %+v ok=%v", pr, ok)
	}
	s.mu.RLock()
	seq := s.prNumberSeq
	s.mu.RUnlock()
	if seq != 481 {
		fail("prNumberSeq after Rust writes = %d, want 481", seq)
	}
	// Inbox upserts keep existing rows' sort, so a prepend ties at 0 and
	// load order among the ties is rowid order; check membership instead.
	var ibRust *domain.InboxItem
	for _, it := range s.Inbox() {
		if it.ID == "ib-rust" {
			ibRust = &it
		}
	}
	if ibRust == nil || !ibRust.Unread || ibRust.Title != "<b>rust</b>" {
		fail("ib-rust = %+v", ibRust)
	}
	if s.Policy().Autonomy != domain.AutonomyCautious || s.Settings().MaxLoops != 6 || s.Resource().ItersToday != 99 {
		fail("singletons policy=%+v maxLoops=%d iters=%d", s.Policy(), s.Settings().MaxLoops, s.Resource().ItersToday)
	}
	if req, at, ok := s.GitHubBranchRequirePR("rust-proj", "acme/rust", "main"); !ok || !req || at.IsZero() {
		fail("rust branch rule = %v %v %v", req, at, ok)
	}
	if a, ok := s.LatestAnalysis("rust-proj", ""); !ok || a.ID != "an-rust" {
		fail("rust analysis = %+v ok=%v", a, ok)
	}
	events, _ := s.EventsForLoop("W-rust")
	if len(events) != 2 || events[1].Type != "workspace.updated" {
		fail("W-rust events = %+v", events)
	}
	msgs, err := s.SessionTranscript("rust-sess")
	if err != nil || len(msgs) != 2 || len(msgs[1].Content) != 2 || msgs[1].InputTokens != 7 {
		fail("rust-sess transcript = %+v err=%v", msgs, err)
	} else if tu, ok := msgs[1].Content[1].AsToolUse(); !ok || string(tu.Input) != `{"cmd":"ls"}` {
		fail("rust-sess tool_use = %+v ok=%v", tu, ok)
	}
	if c, ok := s.ActiveSessionContext("rust-sess"); !ok || c.Summary != "rust summary" {
		fail("rust-sess context = %+v ok=%v", c, ok)
	}
	sess, ok := s.SessionForLoopAgent("W-rust", "PA")
	if !ok || sess.ID != "rust-sess" || sess.ProviderSessionRef != "rust-ref" {
		fail("SessionForLoopAgent(W-rust, PA) = %+v ok=%v", sess, ok)
	}
	forks := 0
	for _, x := range s.SessionsForLoop("W-rust") {
		if x.ParentSessionID == "rust-sess" {
			forks++
		}
	}
	if forks != 1 {
		fail("rust-sess forks = %d", forks)
	}
	scheds, err := s.ScheduledPrompts()
	found := false
	for _, sc := range scheds {
		if sc.ID == "rust-sched" {
			found = true
			if sc.Flags["effort"] != "max" || sc.LastRun == nil || sc.LastRun.WorkspaceID != "W-rust" || sc.NextRunAt != 1767398400000 {
				fail("rust-sched = %+v", sc)
			}
		}
	}
	if err != nil || !found {
		fail("rust-sched missing: err=%v", err)
	}
	if cnt := s.AttentionCounts(); cnt.AppUnseen != 1 {
		fail("AttentionCounts.AppUnseen = %d", cnt.AppUnseen)
	}
}
